name: Taskmaster-1
description: A realistic and diverse dialog dataset containing 13,215 task-based dialogs across six domains, created using both two-person spoken Wizard of Oz and self-dialog approaches to support development of goal-oriented conversational systems.
reputation: Taskmaster-1 is a well-known early task-oriented dialog dataset and has been widely used as a benchmark for goal-oriented conversational systems.
notes: Dialogs are labeled with API calls and arguments, enabling models to interact with multiple services; dataset supports research on spoken vs. written language and discourse phenomena.
